verdict.rationale: Salv documents a CSV data upload endpoint for bulk-loading historical persons and transactions. Clearance rules automatically close every alert that meets set conditions, and customers are re-screened automatically several times a day, so some actions do apply across many items at once. Beyond import and rule-driven auto-closure, there is no documented general bulk action: alert status updates and manual alerts are per-item endpoints. Missing for 10: bulk/batch API endpoints for updating many alerts, persons or cases at once; UI multi-select bulk actions; documented limits or behavior of the bulk upload; independent or hands-on corroboration.
